title: Customer escalation war-room: Acme Payments (prep + notes)
content:
Purpose:
- Prep notes + live war-room running doc for Acme Payments outage impacting tokenization pipeline. Quick reference for on-call, CS, SRE, and account team.

Background / summary (TL;DR):
- First customer report: 2026-03-08 18:12 UTC via support@ (payment failures, 502s from hosted API).
- Severity: Sev1 (payment authorizations failing intermittently; several customers impacted; Acme revenue flow degraded).
- Likely domain: hosted-api routing -> dedicated failover mismatch for tokenization model variant. Hypothesis: config drift after deployment 2026-03-08 16:45 UTC.

Impact:
- Acme Payments: ~30% of tokenization requests returning 502/timeout; retrying causes duplicate charge risk.
- Other customers in same region: partial latency spikes but not full failure (seems targeted to Acme route config).
- Business: urgent; Acme has escalated to their VP of Engineering.

Key contacts / roles (live war-room):
- War-room lead / note taker: Maya Thompson (CS)
- SRE lead: Ben Carter (on-call, eng-sre)
- Serving runtime SME: Luis Gomez (serving-runtime)
- Account exec / customer lead: Evelyn Zhang (customer-success)
- Engineering escalation channel: #escalation-acme-payments (private)
- On-call pager: Ben (primary), DRI fallback: Priya Rao

Meeting agenda (30 min immediate sync):
1) Quick context and impact (5 min)
2) Current state & recent changes (5 min)
3) Triage findings / logs (10 min)
4) Immediate mitigations (5 min)
5) Action items + communication cadence (5 min)

Timeline / recent events:
- 2026-03-08 16:45 UTC: Deploy of routing config for tokenization variant (rolled out to us-east-1).
- 2026-03-08 18:12 UTC: First customer report (Acme).
- 2026-03-08 18:20 UTC: Pager triggered for elevated 5xx rate on route acme-tokenize-prod.
- 2026-03-08 18:35 UTC: Rollback attempted -> partial rollback applied (30% traffic), logs show KV cache mismatches.
- 2026-03-09 02:00 UTC: Intermittent spikes continue; routed incidents to SRE.

Data points / investigation notes:
- Error patterns: 502 + upstream timeouts; stack traces point to model shard handshake failing for quantized variant.
- Logs to check: S3 logs at s3://infra-logs/prod/us-east-1/acme-tokenize/2026-03-08/*, and serving-runtime traces (trace ids included in linked_artifacts).
- Quick check (Ben): config for route acme-tokenize-prod shows a mismatched model_variant tag (expected v3-q8_0, deployed v3-q8_1).
- Hypothesis: v3-q8_1 has different KV expiry behavior causing cache invalidation and upstream timeouts under burst.

Immediate mitigations attempted / proposed:
- Re-route Acme traffic to dedicated fallback variant (v3-std) for now (Ben) -> In progress.
- Increase request timeout and enable aggressive retries at edge for 10 min window (temporary) -> needs approval from infra (Luis).
- Customer-facing message: 15-min update: "We're investigating; mitigation in progress; no charge duplication expected if you do not retry manually" (Evelyn to send).

Open questions / unknowns:
- Why did v3-q8_1 get deployed to Acme route specifically? Was this part of the canary/bucket? (Action: Maya -> check rollout tags / PRs)
- Is there any persisted data risk due to retries? Need finance/ops input.
- Does rollback to v3-q8_0 fully restore behavior or is config stateful (cache priming needed)? (Luis to test).

Communications plan:
- External updates to Acme: every 30 minutes until stable, then hourly. Evelyn owns external comms.
- Internal updates: War-room notes updated in this doc; Slack channel for async updates. Escalate to CTO if not resolved in 2 hours.

Action items (live tracking):
- Ben Carter: Reroute Acme traffic to fallback model variant v3-std (immediate). Due: 2026-03-09 09:00 UTC. Status: in_progress.
- Luis Gomez: Validate whether v3-q8_1 KV expiry differs and test a rollback in staging (include cache priming steps). Due: 2026-03-09 10:30 UTC. Status: todo.
- Maya Thompson: Pull deploy history / canary buckets for acme-tokenize-prod, link PRs and recent CI runs. Due: 2026-03-09 09:30 UTC. Status: todo.
- Evelyn Zhang: Draft and send 15-min customer update to Acme, coordinate with legal for wording around retries. Due: 2026-03-09 08:45 UTC. Status: todo.
- Priya Rao: Monitor payment gateway client errors for duplication spikes; escalate to payments-ops if duplicates > 0.5%. Due: 2026-03-09 11:00 UTC. Status: todo.
- Maya Thompson: Schedule follow-up war-room call in 30 minutes; include eng-sre, serving-runtime, account team. Due: 2026-03-09 08:35 UTC. Status: done.

Post-meeting notes (to fill during war-room):
- Time call started: 
- Key findings: 
- Decision log (rollbacks, reroutes): 
- Communication sent (time + URL): 

RCA outline (postmortem template):
- Incident summary (what happened, when)
- Impact (customers, revenue, downstream systems)
- Root cause (technical + process)
- Timeline of key events
- Actions (short-term mitigations and long-term fixes)
- Owners and deadlines

Notes to self / scratchpad: 
- Check billing triggers for Acme during incident window (billing team contact: amy@redwood.com).
- Attach trace ids and minimal repro script to JIRA-4321.
- Consider gating quantized variants behind opt-in feature flag for high-value customers.

Last updated: 2026-03-10 01:12 UTC (Maya)
